name: Zanzil's Secret

meta.next: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout

summary: Crank Fizzlebub seeks Zanzil's Secret in the ruins northeast of Booty Bay. The exiled troll's brew bends minds and strengthens bodies, and Crank wants samples for himself.

sections.title: Mind-Bending Draughts
sections.body: Northeast of Booty Bay, Zanzil has made his home in the ruins of Jubuwal and Aboraz. His former tribal leaders cast him out, fearing his mastery over other minds. Now he rules followers with concoctions made from jungle plants. The mixtures dull their will and heighten their strength, leaving them docile but sturdy.

sections.title: A Lucrative Mixture
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub sees profit in Zanzil's craft. Those who want power over others might pay handsomely for such a brew, so the goblin wants a supply from the ruins. Deliver enough samples and Crank offers the usual coin, with a quiet bonus if you keep the bargain private.

faq.answer: Zanzil is a troll exile who lives in the ruins northeast of Booty Bay. His leaders banished him because they feared his power over other minds.

faq.q: What does Zanzil's mixture actually do?
faq.answer: Made from jungle plants, Zanzil's brew suppresses the drinker's free will and unnaturally strengthens the body.
Zanzil and his followers live in the ruins of Jubuwal and Aboraz, northeast of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Crank Fizzlebub want the mixture?
aliases: why does crank want the mixture
what will crank do with zanzils mixture
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub believes those who want power over others would pay well for the brew, and he has uses of his own in mind.

faq.q: Why did Crank pay extra upon delivery?
faq.answer: Crank adds a bonus to buy your discretion and keep the acquisition of the mind-bending brew private.
